commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
feat: Enhance VectorStoreService with content extraction strategies and add WebSearchServiceFactory

- Added common field keys for content, title, and source extraction in VectorStoreService.
- Refactored content extraction methods to utilize new field keys.
- Introduced WebSearchServiceFactory for creating instances of web search services.
- Updated ConsoleLogger to streamline logging with color-coded messages.
- Modified ServiceContainer to include optional WebSearch service.
- Refactored Program.cs to initialize WebSearch service alongside existing services.
- Improved SlackEntityResolver to handle channel type resolution more efficiently.
- Simplified SlackMessageHandler to consolidate message response logic.
- Added unit tests for TavilySearchService to ensure correct API interaction and error handling.
- Created unit tests for WebSearchResult extension methods to validate markdown formatting.

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Remove redundant documentation files

- CHANGELOG.md: Git history and GitHub releases serve this purpose
- CONFIGURATION.md: appsettings.json files are self-documenting

commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Add implementation plan for MCP client and web search

- Create PLAN.md with revised implementation approach
- Phase A: Native Tavily web search (simpler than MCP)
- Phase B: HTTP-only MCP client infrastructure
- Phase C: GitHub migration to MCP
- Defer Confluence/JIRA (no official MCP servers)
- Skip stdio transport (incompatible with Azure Container Apps)

Relates to #8
